title: Vakter threat-feed manifest
description: Table of contents for a Vakter daily threat-feed bundle. Canonical spec lives at openspec/changes/vakter-watch-pivot/specs/threat-feed/bundle-schema.md.

schema_version.description: Schema axis. Current value: 1. Clients refuse bundles whose schema_version exceeds the highest version they know.

bundle_version.description: Date-based version, YYYY.MM.DD or YYYY.MM.DD.N for same-day re-publishes.

published_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the bundle was signed. Must end in 'Z'.

feed_host.description: Publishing host. The client requires this exact value.

publisher_key_id.description: Identifier of the Ed25519 key that signed the tarball. Quarter-rotated.

files.description: Exactly 8 entries — the 8 canonical category files.

total_entry_count.description: Sum of entry_count across files. Cross-checked at the client.

previous_bundle_version.description: Previous bundle's bundle_version. Absent for the first bundle ever published.

previous_bundle_sha256.description: Previous bundle's tarball sha256. Absent for the first bundle ever published.

name.description: Filename inside the tarball. No path components.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the file's bytes.

entry_count.description: For .txt files: non-comment, non-blank line count. For .json files: top-level array length.

category.description: One of the 8 canonical category slugs. Unique across the files array.
